about: AviationWeather.gov (NOAA Aviation Weather Center) public Data API. The CLI fetches METARs, TAFs, PIREPs, SIGMETs/AIRMETs, international SIGMETs, winds aloft, and airport/station info. No login is needed.

commands.summary: Get decoded METAR observations by station ICAO ids or inside a lat/lon bounding box, optionally with hours of history

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated ICAO station ids, e.g. KORD,KJFK. Pass either ids or bbox.

params.name: bbox
params.description: Bounding box as minLat,minLon,maxLat,maxLon, e.g. 39,-106,41,-104. Use it instead of ids.

params.name: hours
params.description: Hours of observations to return. 0 or omitted returns only the most recent report.

commands.summary: Get TAF terminal forecasts for ICAO station ids, optionally with the latest METAR

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated ICAO station ids, e.g. KSEA,KLAX

params.name: metar
params.description: Also include the latest METAR for each station

commands.summary: Get airport details: name, location, elevation, runways and frequencies

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated airport ICAO ids, e.g. KDEN

commands.summary: Get weather station metadata: ICAO/IATA/WMO ids, site name, location, and product types (METAR/TAF)

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated station ICAO ids, e.g. KSEA

commands.summary: Search pilot reports (PIREPs/AIREPs) near a station by distance and age, or inside a bounding box, optionally filtered by intensity

params.name: id
params.description: Center station ICAO id, e.g. KDEN. Use with distance.

params.name: distance
params.description: Radius around the station in statute miles, e.g. 200

params.name: age
params.description: Maximum report age in hours, e.g. 1.5 or 6

commands.summary: List active domestic (US) SIGMETs and convective SIGMETs, optionally filtered by hazard

params.name: hazard
params.description: Hazard type filter: conv (convective), turb (turbulence), ice (icing), ifr

commands.summary: List current G-AIRMETs: sierra (IFR/mountain obscuration), tango (turbulence/wind/LLWS), zulu (icing/freezing level)

params.name: type
params.description: G-AIRMET product type: sierra, tango or zulu. The server may ignore it, so check the 'product' field of each result.

commands.summary: List active international SIGMETs by FIR (tropical cyclones, volcanic ash, turbulence, icing, thunderstorms)

params.name: hazard
params.description: Optional hazard filter: turb or ice

commands.summary: Get the FD winds/temperatures aloft forecast text for a region, altitude band and forecast period

params.name: level
params.description: Altitude band: low (3000-39000 ft) or high (FL450+)
